tools.name: tree
tools.title: Directory tree
tools.description: Scan a directory natively; return ASCII or compact JSON with file byte sizes. No shell or child process.

format.description: JSON text contains root, columns, depth-first entries, truncated and incomplete.

maxDepth.description: Maximum directory levels to list; depth cutoffs are marked.

tools.name: help
tools.title: Help
tools.description: Browse help indexes and command details by path. Empty path opens the root.

path.description: Full space-separated topic path, e.g. vs build or shell cmd. Omit for root.

tools.name: vs
tools.title: Visual Studio
tools.description: Build one solution target with MSBuild or run the solution through devenv.

msbuild.description: Full MSBuild executable path using forward slashes; required for build.

project.description: MSBuild solution target name, including solution folders when applicable; required for build.

configuration.description: Exact solution configuration such as Debug|x64; required for build.

tools.name: cmd
tools.title: Command Prompt
tools.description: Execute caller-supplied cmd code. Optional elevation requests UAC; not a sandbox.

command.description: Shell command/script. Normal calls wait and return combined stdout/stderr and exit code.

elevated.description: Request Windows UAC elevation. Launch-only: no captured output or completion status.

tools.name: powershell
tools.title: PowerShell
tools.description: Execute caller-supplied powershell code. Optional elevation requests UAC; not a sandbox.

command.description: Shell command/script. Normal calls wait and return combined stdout/stderr and exit code.

elevated.description: Request Windows UAC elevation. Launch-only: no captured output or completion status.

tools.name: wsl
tools.title: WSL Linux
tools.description: Run /bin/sh in the installed default WSL distribution as its configured user. Does not install or convert WSL.

command.description: Shell command/script. Normal calls wait and return combined stdout/stderr and exit code.
